description: Given two or more standard 5-field cron expressions, find every minute over the next N days where two or more of them fire at the same time, for example a nightly backup job colliding with a report job. Returns each colliding minute with the zero-based indexes of every expression that matched.

expressions.description: Two to ten standard 5-field cron expressions to check against each other

windowDays.description: How many days ahead to check, default 30

name: find_cron_overlaps
